title: Luang Prabang Half Marathon 2026 Review: A UNESCO Old Town Run for Children
seo_title: Luang Prabang Half Marathon 2026 Review | Laos UNESCO Race
meta_description: The Luang Prabang Half Marathon 2026: October 24 through Laos's UNESCO old town. 21.1K along the Mekong, organised by Lao Friends Hospital for Children — registration open.
dek: Set for 24 October 2026 on a loop course through Luang Prabang's UNESCO-listed old town along the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers, this charity half marathon is organised by Lao Friends Hospital for Children. Registration open. One of Southeast Asia's most beautiful race settings.
verdict: The Luang Prabang Half Marathon is arguably the most beautiful race setting in Laos — a 21.1K loop through the UNESCO World Heritage old town, along the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers, past gilded temples and French-colonial villas at the tail of the rainy season. Organised by Lao Friends Hospital for Children as a charity event, it carries genuine community purpose. October in Luang Prabang is the end of the wet season: expect humid conditions but also lush green landscapes and manageable morning temperatures. For runners wanting a Laos race with world-class scenery, cultural immersion, and a charitable cause, this is the standout pick in the country.

sections.heading: UNESCO Old Town: A World Heritage Course
paragraphs: The course loops through Luang Prabang's UNESCO-listed old town — a peninsula between the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers, dotted with gilded Buddhist temples, French-colonial buildings, and morning alms-giving processions. [1] It's one of the most photogenic race settings in Southeast Asia, comparable to Angkor Wat or Bagan for cultural atmosphere.
